summary: Exploratory recipe search on visible validation. Runs a project command once per recipe x seed x fold in a private work dir: config.command.argv ("python" or an absolute path first; {work} {out} {seed} {fold} {folds} {params_json} {recipe} and {param.NAME} substituted), which writes numeric metrics to {out}/receipt.json. config.space is grid or random (with a seed), config.seed_policy gives seeds and folds, config.budget needs max_trials or max_seconds, config.stopping is none, patience or target. Outputs: evidence_table (every recipe, ranked, with its metrics) and best_recipe. Without a source bundle, config.command.copy must list the project files to copy. Each evaluation runs in a scrubbed environment and its own process group. No claim and no test data; lock the winner before independent confirmation.

files.description: optional port->plain filename map; ports not listed are staged as <port><ext>

copy.description: plain file names copied from the project directory into each work dir; required without a source bundle. Nothing is copied implicitly, and a file named after a test or held-out split is refused.

metrics_file.description: JSON object of numeric metrics written under {out}; default receipt.json

recipe.description: optional recipe template: any JSON, with {"$param": NAME} replaced, written to {recipe} in the work dir

parameters.description: name -> {values: [...]}, or for random also {low, high, log?, integer?}

metric.description: a visible-validation metric from the command's receipt, e.g. validation_accuracy; a test or held-out metric is refused

folds.description: folds of the visible data; the command reads {fold} of {folds} and owns the split

budget.description: at least one of max_trials (recipes) and max_seconds
